data.summary: Sportverein Beispielau 1911 e.V. writes that the direct debit for the 2026 family membership fee was returned by the bank, and asks Johanna Beispielacker to transfer the outstanding €172.50 (fee plus return-debit charge) to the club's account by 3 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your club's automatic bank collection for the 2026 family membership fee failed, and the club was charged a return-debit fee, which has been added to what you owe. You need to transfer the total amount shown to the club's bank account by the stated date to settle this. If your bank details have changed, send the club a new SEPA mandate instead of just paying, so future collections work. If you do nothing, the amount stays open and the club may try to collect it again or add further charges.
